changes: Added a built-in **Launcher Changelog** that appears after a fresh install or update. Click the launcher version at any time to reopen it and view older changelogs.
Added direct access to the **Discord support thread** from the changelog.
Added an **On/Off toggle for Game Settings Profiles**, allowing profiles to be paused without deleting them.
Before Play, the launcher now detects changed in-game settings and lets you either **save them to the selected profile** or **use the saved profile**.
Added an in-game **FOV Slider** in the Video Settings.
DLC files now overwrite mismatched DLC files, with originals restored when removing the DLC.
Added performance command information for `-toggleallsuits` and `-togglebrokensuits`.
Added warnings for launch arguments already handled automatically by the launcher.
[DEV TAB] Added experimental **DXVK** versions: **2.6.2** or **3.0.2**.
Added the **Carbon Capture** PvP map DLC pack.
Added the **Factory 3-4 PvE Maps** DLC: Central Industrial Complex and Recycling Plant 37.
Added **DLC enable/disable** command tips.
Added a copyable in-game chat command reference to the **Info / FAQ** tab.
Added up to 5 switchable game-settings profiles.
Released the optional Game Client Patch, fixing scope in/out stutters.
Added clearer per-patch Apply/Remove controls and enabled indicators. All patches are now optional.
Added Reset All Settings recovery to the Diagnostics tab.
Added a FAQ with useful game and account tips.
Added live player count.
Added Agenda Stats.
Added the Servers tab.
Fixed bugs and reorganized the launcher.

versions.title: First Release
versions.summary: The launcher is now available with several useful options and quality-of-life improvements.
changes: Automatic updates whenever a new launcher version is released.
Easy game configuration and server launching.
Small client-side fixes.
Support for larger client-side patches in the future.
